title: rewards.level.achieved v1
description: Emitted when a user's accumulated points cross a level threshold. Source: alebrije-mod-rewards-go (Go). STATUS 2026-07-03 (DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-rewards): NOT IMPLEMENTED. grep of the whole alebrije monorepo found zero producers of event_type rewards.level.achieved; the real publisher (internal/service/events_publisher.go) has no PublishLevelAchieved method and no 'level' concept -- only 'tier' (see rewards.tier_changed.v1.json). Moved out of event-schemas/ into planned/ so the Go/Python/Elixir validators (which only scan the top-level schemas dir) stop registering a schema with no producer. Kept (not deleted) in case a future level system is built on this contract; do not restore to the top-level dir until a real producer exists.

user_id.description: User who achieved the new level.

previous_level.description: Level the user was at before this achievement.

achieved_at.description: Timestamp when the level was achieved.

points_at_achievement.description: Total points balance at the moment of level-up.

level_name.description: Display name of the new level (e.g. Silver, Gold).

badge_id.description: Badge awarded with this level, if configured.
